question: 查询员工总人数，只返回员工总数。
查询员工总人数，只返回员工总数。
查询每个部门的员工人数，返回部门名称和员工人数，并按部门名称升序排序。
sql:
SELECT d."name", COUNT(e."id") AS employee_count
FROM "departments" d
LEFT JOIN "employees" e ON e."department_id" = d."id"
GROUP BY d."id", d."name"
ORDER BY d."name" ASC;

question: 查询每个部门的员工人数，返回部门名称和员工人数，并按部门名称升序排序。
sql:
SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.department_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
ORDER BY d.name ASC;
